en.headline: Five property owners fined over HK$320,000 for ignoring removal orders
en.dek: The Buildings Department said the convictions at Sha Tin and West Kowloon courts involved unauthorised walls, rooftop structures and other works.
body: Five property owners were convicted and fined a total of HK$323,170 at Magistrates' Courts on Wednesday for failing to comply with removal orders issued under the Buildings Ordinance, the Buildings Department said.

In the first case, the owner of a detached house on Sha Tin Heights Road was fined HK$109,920, including daily penalties of HK$99,920, over an unauthorised retaining wall and backfill works carried out without approval. A second owner of a village house in Sha Tin was fined HK$97,480 on a second prosecution for an unauthorised rooftop structure after failing to comply earlier.

A third owner in Sha Tin was fined HK$65,770, also on a repeat prosecution, for unauthorised structures on a yard and flat roof. Two co-owners of a unit on Castle Peak Road in Tsing Lung Tau were fined HK$50,000 in total for works including removal of fixed windows and erection of railings on flower beds. The department said it would continue strict enforcement against non-compliance to protect building and public safety.

zh.headline: 五名業主未遵清拆令共罰逾32萬元
zh.dek: 屋宇署表示，沙田及西九龍裁判法院裁定的案件涉及僭建護土牆、天台搭建物及其他工程。
body: 屋宇署表示，五名業主因未遵從根據《建築物條例》發出的清拆令，周三於裁判法院被定罪並共罰款32萬3170元。
首宗個案中，沙田嶺路一幢獨立屋的業主因未獲批准的僭建護土牆及回填工程，被判罰款109,920元，當中包括按日罰款99,920元。第二名沙田村屋業主因天台僭建物持續不遵從清拆令而遭第二次檢控，罰款97,480元。
第三名沙田業主同樣因第二次檢控，就庭院及閣樓平台的僭建物被罰65,770元。荃灣青龍頭青山公路一單位的兩名共同業主，因拆除固定窗及在花槽加建圍欄等工程，共被罰5萬元。屋宇署指會繼續嚴厲執法，以保障樓宇及公眾安全。
